keyboard_review_navigation_playback_save.summary: Two Playwright journeys passed: keyboard search entry and match navigation; Alt+1/2/0 view navigation; keyboard review-basis and transcript editing; Ctrl+S source save; autosave recovery and discard; Enter activates evidence playback with audio seek assertion; Enter activates approved JSON export.

runtime.browser: Playwright channel chrome; version not separately captured

supported_claims: The tested review interactions support keyboard entry, search navigation, view shortcuts, source saving, evidence playback, local-draft recovery/discard, and JSON export.
Enter on a focused evidence control seeks playback to the linked source interval; Enter on a focused JSON export control downloads the approved note.
limitations: Playwright programmatically focused evidence and export buttons before key activation; sequential tab-order and screen-reader review were not established by this run.
One compressed-upload case was skipped because PyAV is unavailable locally.
The fixture uses a scripted non-ASR provider and does not establish clinical usability or clinical approval.
